principle: NO pre-stored banks; live encyclopedia fetch only; maximum parallel tool-using agents; separate checker agents at every step; search = integrity check not novelty gate.

params.stage1_url_verify_note: CHANGED from WebFetch: WebFetch was HTTP-403 on ALL target domains (wikipedia/ncatlab/biorxiv/arxiv). The signal that actually worked was independent WebSearch confirmation + cross-agent author-list agreement on recent arXiv IDs. Do not spend WebFetch calls on these domains.
params.stage2_bias_note: NEW heuristic from cycle-1 data: the lone survivor proposed a concrete buildable artifact (a codeable positional encoding); merges asserting grand cross-domain 'bounds/theorems' (M4-T1, M4-T2) were trivial-variants and physics-pun merges (M1-T2, M2-T1, M2-T2) were hallucinations. Bias generation toward concrete constructions.
params.stage3_tiebreak_note: NEW: cycle 1 auto-DROPPED 4 merges on 2-checker disagreement (0.50 disagreement rate). Some may be genuine. Next cycle: on disagreement, spawn a 3rd tie-break checker instead of auto-dropping.
params.stage3_analogy_probe_note: NEW: fold Stage-4's most productive test into Stage 3 (cheaper, earlier) — ask checkers to also flag (a) 'does the shared mechanism reduce to a known result?' and (b) 'is a borrowed mechanism applied OUTSIDE its validated domain?' (the QUEST-off-domain issue AUD1 caught).
params.checker_id_verify_note: NEW: checkers in Stage 3 (K1 cited 2603.08239) and Stage 5 (several near-miss IDs) cited unverified arXiv IDs that may be self-hallucinations. Any ID cited as evidence must itself be verified. Closes a residual fabrication vector introduced by the checkers themselves.

stage6b_expected_value_gate.note: NEW, highest-priority change (from AUD2). The pipeline currently MUST emit a 'best survivor' even at ~10-15% win odds, manufacturing a survivor and risking promoting 'least-bad of 18' as 'worth pursuing.' Add a terminal EV gate that can output NO_NICHE_THIS_CYCLE when the best survivor is below threshold. Under this gate, cycle-1's MODEST_INCREMENTAL survivor would be labeled SEED_ONLY (below promote threshold), which is the honest call.

convergence.notes: Algorithm-improvement is the evaluated quantity, not niche count (R9). Cycle 1 = cold-start baseline. The measured value of redundancy (4 flips / 57% false-positive reduction at Stage 3) and the 6 queued param upgrades are the cycle's real output.

metrics_history.headline_measurement: Redundant cross-checking at the integrity stage cut the pass set 7->3 (a ~57% reduction in false-positive 'genuine' verdicts) at a 0.50 inter-checker disagreement rate. Direct empirical support for the core architecture thesis (R3/R10): more independent tool-using checkers measurably reduce hallucination/over-acceptance.

update_log.rationale: Cold start. Default params: 6 knowledge branches + redundancy 2 at the integrity stage.

changes: stage1_fetch_agents 6->8 (+2 branches: control-theory, information-theory) — diversity originates at fetch; scale breadth.
stage1_url_verify_method -> websearch_confirm + cross_agent_author_match (WebFetch 403 everywhere; codify what worked).
stage2_prefer_buildable_artifact_over_grand_unification = true (survivor was buildable; grand-theorem merges were trivial-variants, physics-pun merges were hallucinations).
stage3_tiebreak_on_disagreement = true (recover possibly-genuine merges instead of auto-dropping on 0.50 disagreement).
stage3_include_analogy_collapse_probe = true + checker_must_verify_own_cited_ids = true (catch trivial-variants earlier; close checker self-hallucination vector).
stage6b_expected_value_gate enabled (HIGHEST PRIORITY, from AUD2): allow NO_NICHE_THIS_CYCLE output so the pipeline stops manufacturing a survivor; this cycle's survivor would be SEED_ONLY under it.
update_log.rationale: Every change is traceable to a concrete cycle-1 measurement or auditor finding. The most important structural fix is the terminal EV gate: the pipeline must be able to honestly output 'nothing worth promoting this cycle,' consistent with the project's 0/1071 base-rate lineage. Net algorithm-improvement this cycle: established the live-fetch (no-banks) architecture with 0 fabrication, quantified the value of redundant checking (57% false-positive reduction), and produced a prioritized, evidence-backed upgrade list for cycle 2.
